title: Add a csv output format next to json and yaml (there is no yaml)
pain: A new output format has to be wired through registry, config validation, CLI help, docs and tests, and the prompt names a yaml format that does not exist.
prompt: Add a csv output format to tally, alongside the json and yaml ones. It should work from the command line and from tally.config.json, and be documented. Commit when it's done.

criteria.text: `node bin/tally.js test/fixtures/sample.json --format csv` prints a header line name,count,note and three data rows in count-descending order, with RFC 4180 escaping: the row for `Doe, Jane` has its name in double quotes, the note `said "hello"` is written as `"said ""hello"""`, and the note containing a newline is quoted (not split into an unquoted extra line).
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: A tally.config.json containing {"format":"csv"} loads without error (src/config-schema.js ALLOWED_FORMATS includes csv, not only the registry in src/formats/index.js) and the CLI then outputs csv when no --format is given; an unknown format such as xml is still rejected.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: Wiring is complete: the usage string in bin/tally.js reads json|text|csv (or equivalent listing csv), docs/formats.md has a csv row, docs/cli.md and README.md list csv, CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased entry, test/formats.test.js no longer asserts only ['json','text'] and there is at least one new csv test; `node --test` passes in the final tree.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The final answer tells the owner that the repository has no yaml format (only json and text), and no yaml format or yaml file is added.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: Process: the agent ran the CLI with --format csv against test/fixtures/sample.json (or equivalent input with a comma, a quote and a newline) in the shell, not only the unit tests, and committed the result in one or more commits touching only tally files (no stray files).
criteria.label: process
